appliesTo: the shared Nord Stage 4 control deck, common to every variant
keybedNote: The keybed (key count, range, action) and overall silhouette are variant-specific. Read the run's selected variant in specs/nord-stage-4.variants.json for the source image, measured bounds, aspect ratio, and key model. The control-deck spec below is identical across all three variants.

performance.note: The Rotary Speaker block sits on the exposed red chassis in this band, below Master Level — see reference/nord-stage-4-73.jpg, where it spans roughly x 2200-2500 of 11600 (about 0.10-0.13 of the instrument width, inside this section). It is an organ effect functionally but is placed here physically; score placement against the photograph.

horizontalSectionsNote: Fractions photo-measured on nord-stage-4-73.jpg (band scan of the deck at y≈706-786, deck extent x≈1300-10300); corrected 2026-07-04 — the previous coarse values (piano 0.15, program 0.09, synth 0.21) contradicted the photo.

landmarkScoring.presence: A required landmark counts as present when it is rendered in its own section, whatever its z-order or whether a pointer can reach it. Presence is about inventory and placement.
landmarkScoring.reachability: Whether a control can actually be operated is measured separately, by the reachability method in the rubric. A rendered-but-buried control is present and unreachable — it must not be counted against both.
landmarkScoring.method: Compare against sectionLandmarks and the assigned variant reference image. Where this spec and the photograph disagree, the photograph wins and the disagreement is a spec bug worth reporting.
